common_intent_requirements.text: 从装着半杯水的透明量杯里倒一些水进另一个空杯
common_intent_requirements.normal_source_quote: 从装着半杯水的透明量杯里倒一些水进另一个空杯
common_intent_requirements.h3_refined_evidence: a transparent measuring cup containing about half a cup of water beside an empty cup on a tabletop. Both vessels and their water levels remain clearly visible. A hand lifts the measuring cup and gently tips its opening over the empty cup. A stream travels downward into the receiving cup. As some water transfers, the amount remaining in the measuring cup visibly decreases while the receiving cup fills.
As some water transfers, the amount remaining in the measuring cup visibly decreases while the receiving cup fills.
Water remains inside the two vessels, with the tabletop dry.

physics_checks.criterion: 可见水流转移时，源容器的液量总体减少，接收容器总体增加，没有无来源增水。
physics_checks.observable_evidence: 对比倾倒前后两容器水量，并确认中间存在从源到目标的水流。
fail_examples: 接收杯明显增加而源容器水量始终不变
两杯液量同时无来源增加
源容器的水消失但接收杯未获得也无其他流出
not_required: 不根据不同形状容器的液面高度推算精确体积
不要求实时液面变化逐帧单调，允许晃动

evaluation_boundary: Assess only supplied requirements. Professional additions are not hidden requirements for ordinary input.
